vibe.title: Vibe Check
vibe.content:
SLOW JAM: BRIAN MCKNIGHT, "BACK AT ONE" (1999)
• STAT: Released Aug. 9, 1999, as the lead single from his album of the same name, it reached No. 2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and went top 10 in Canada and New Zealand.
• STORY: The whole song counts up, one, two, three, four, five, and then he's back at one. It's the ultimate 'start over' slow jam.
• WHY TODAY: Day after Thanksgiving. Leftovers in the fridge, the tree is coming out, and we're all back at one.
➜ TAKE: Every 1999 wedding DJ played this right after the cake. Every single one.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's the song that was playing at your first dance, prom or wedding?
😂 JOKES: One, you're like a dream come true. Two, you brought the leftovers. Three, they're in my fridge now. / Brian McKnight counted to five in this song. Most of us lost count of pie slices at three.

🚗 DRIVE TEASE: Mild for late November. About 38 at 6 AM, 39 by 8, with a north wind around 10 mph. Mostly cloudy, high near 48. Dry roads.

📅 THIS DAY: THE FIRST MACY'S PARADE, NOV. 27, 1924
• It started as the Macy's Christmas Parade, on Nov. 27, 1924, to push holiday shopping at the new flagship store on 34th Street.
• So 102 years ago today the very first one marched, and this year's 100th edition got bumped to tomorrow by the storm. It began as a shopping promotion, so a Saturday after Black Friday is honestly on brand.
➜ TAKE: The parade was invented to sell stuff. Moving it to the weekend after Black Friday is the most Macy's move ever.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's the first parade you remember going to?
😂 JOKES: The 1924 parade had Santa on a sleigh. The 2026 parade has a 60 mph wind delay and a Snoopy in a warehouse in Jersey. / A hundred and two years ago today. And it's still the only place you can see a 50-foot Pikachu without a ticket.

💡 FUN FACT: PHILLY COPS NAMED BLACK FRIDAY, AND IT WASN'T A COMPLIMENT
• Police in Philadelphia used 'Black Friday' to describe the crowds and traffic jams that kicked off Christmas shopping.
• In 1961, Philadelphia merchants hired a PR expert who tried to rebrand it 'Big Friday.' Nobody went for it.
➜ TAKE: Somebody tried to rename Black Friday to 'Big Friday' and the whole country said 'no thanks.' Marketing has never recovered.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: rename Black Friday. What should it be called?
😂 JOKES: 'Big Friday' sounds like a casual-dress day at a bank. / Black Friday was named by traffic cops. That's why it comes with a headache.

🎉 NATIONAL DAYS (Fri Nov 27, verified on National Day Calendar and Days of the Year): Black Friday · Buy Nothing Day · National Day of Listening · Native American Heritage Day · National Bavarian Cream Pie Day · National Craft Jerky Day · National Flossing Day · Maize Day · You're Welcomegiving Day · Fur-Free Friday · Pins and Needles Day · National Illustration Day · Sinkie Day · Turtle Adoption Day

GOOD MORNING UP NORTH: Mostly cloudy today with a high near 48, easing back to about 46 this afternoon, and a north wind around 10. Tonight's low is about 35. Saturday is mostly cloudy, high near 46, with a 30 percent chance of rain in the afternoon.

SCHOOLS: No closings or delays listed this morning.

ROADS: No verified problems. Clear for Black Friday shopping.

🌊 WIND & WAVES: Small Craft Advisory on Grand Traverse Bay and the Lake Michigan shore through this evening. North wind 10-15 knots, Bay waves 2-3 ft, Lake Michigan 2-4 ft.

🍂 TOWN BUZZ: City of TC offices are closed today. Final leaf pickup is the week of Nov 30, so leaves go to the curb by Sunday.

ENERGY: Black Friday. Leftovers in the fridge, doorbusters downtown, Mariah is officially allowed, and the Macy's parade is tomorrow morning.

🎉 NATIONAL DAYS: BIT MATERIAL
• BLACK FRIDAY: Bit: the Jingle All the Way 'Turbo Man' store scene (it's in today's opener, c00). Line: 'Turbo Man's only the hottest selling Christmas toy ever!' Also the 1961 'Big Friday' rebrand flop (Fun Fact).
• BUY NOTHING DAY: Bit: Team Doorbuster vs. Team Buy Nothing call-in (Conversation Bits). Line: 'I'm celebrating Buy Nothing Day by filling my online cart and not checking out.'
• NATIONAL DAY OF LISTENING: Bit: ask the best story from the Thanksgiving table; MH Minute ties in (phone in the other room). Classic line: 'Are you listening to me?' 'Huh?'
• NATIVE AMERICAN HERITAGE DAY: Straight mention, no jokes. Local tie from this week's news: St. Ignace birch bark canoe maker Ron Paquin's Joyce Award (UpNorthLive Nov 25).
• NATIONAL FLOSSING DAY: Bit: the day after Thanksgiving, everybody's flossing out turkey. Callback: the Floss dance (Backpack Kid, then the Fortnite emote). Ask who in the house can still do it.
• NATIONAL BAVARIAN CREAM PIE DAY: Bit: one more pie day, the day after the pie holiday. 'My doctor says I'm on a pie-free diet. Free pie, I eat it.'
• NATIONAL CRAFT JERKY DAY: Bit: 'Black Friday survival kit: jerky, a phone charger, and a parking spot.'
• MAIZE DAY: Bit: tie to the corn on the table yesterday; Michigan maize-and-blue goes to Columbus tomorrow.
• YOU'RE WELCOMEGIVING DAY: Bit: the day you get to say 'you're welcome' for everything you cooked. Callback: Maui's 'You're Welcome' from Moana (2016).
• ALSO LISTED: Fur-Free Friday, Pins and Needles Day, National Illustration Day, Sinkie Day, Turtle Adoption Day (Days of the Year). Mention only.

👀 LOOK-AHEAD: Sat Nov 28: Small Business Saturday, National French Toast Day, Red Planet Day. Sun Nov 29: National Square Dancing Day, Electronic Greetings Day, National Lemon Cream Pie Day, Throw Out Your Leftovers Day. Mon Nov 30: Cyber Monday, National Mason Jar Day, National Mousse Day, National Personal Space Day, Blue Beanie Day. (Days of the Year date pages, checked 3:49 AM ET.)

buzz.title: Daily Buzz
buzz.content:
━━ LOCAL ━━

⭐ KALKASKA DANCERS STUCK IN NEW YORK AFTER THE MACY'S PARADE GOT PUSHED
• SUMMARY: Fifteen dancers from Kalkaska's Fitch Dance Company flew to New York City to perform in the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. Then Macy's pushed the parade from Thursday to Saturday because of the storm, the first postponement in the parade's 100 years. The group, about 60 people with families and coaches, is now scrambling over hotels, food and flights.
• THE CATCH: Director Candace Musselman says they found out from an NBC post on social media and honestly thought it was a hoax. The performance company's hotel deal only covers the dancers, so parents have to find their own rooms over a holiday weekend in Manhattan.
• WHO: Fitch Dance Company, Kalkaska, director Candace Musselman. WHAT: Parade moved to Sat Nov 28, 8:30 AM on NBC. WHERE: New York City. WHY IT MATTERS: Months of practice and fundraising, and some families may have to head home before the kids get to march.
➜ TAKE: Our kids trained all year for the biggest parade on Earth, and the weather said 'how about Saturday.' Northern Michigan families know a storm delay when they see one. Let's get these dancers some love.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: send a shout-out to the Fitch Dance Company kids stuck in New York. We'll read them on air.
😂 JOKES: Kalkaska to Times Square is a big jump. Kalkaska to Times Square with a two-day weather delay is just a really expensive layover. / Up here we'd call 60 mph gusts 'a Tuesday on the bay.' New York called off the whole parade.

TC TURKEY TROT SETS AN ALL-TIME RECORD: NEARLY 3,000
• Nearly 3,000 runners and walkers turned out downtown Thanksgiving morning for the 19th annual Traverse City Turkey Trot, the biggest crowd it has ever had. There was a 5-K and the five-mile race called the Five Mile Flyer.
• Traverse City Central senior Evan Fox won the five-miler, per 9&10. People came from as far as Washington, D.C., and plenty pulled kids in wagons. MC Kat Paye called the trotters 'memory makers.'
➜ TAKE: Three thousand people ran five miles so they could eat 5,000 calories. That's not a race, that's a down payment.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: did you trot yesterday? Give us your time, your costume, or your excuse.
😂 JOKES: Evan Fox won the five-miler. Most of us were still deciding if the couch counted as stretching. / Record turnout for the Turkey Trot. The turkeys did not attend. Smart birds.

BLACK FRIDAY IN DOWNTOWN TC: DOORBUSTERS, FREE WRAPPING, SHOP-SMALL SATURDAY
• Downtown Traverse City's Black Friday and Small Business Saturday run today and tomorrow, with participating shops and restaurants offering deals, samples and a free gift-wrapping station.
• A few from the DTCA list: Glik's first 50 customers get a coupon for 50% off one item priced $100 or less, and one downtown shop has $3.50 cherry stocking-stuffer snack packs, Friday only.
• Owners at Lakes and Grapes and Serendipity told 9&10 this is one of their biggest weekends, and Small Business Saturday is tomorrow, Nov 28.
➜ TAKE: Big-box stores open at 5 AM with a stampede. Downtown TC opens with gift wrap and cherry samples. I know which line I'm in.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: are you out shopping today, or are you a Black Friday couch shopper?

blackfriday.content:
NRF: 183 MILLION SHOPPERS THIS WEEKEND, 126 MILLION TODAY
• The National Retail Federation, in a Nov. 19 survey with Prosper Insights & Analytics, says 182.7 million people planned to shop this Thanksgiving weekend, a little under last year's 186.9 million.

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
PUT THE PHONE IN THE OTHER ROOM FOR ONE CONVERSATION

It's the National Day of Listening, and a lot of us still have family in the house. Here's one small move for today. Pick one conversation, and before it starts, put your phone in another room. Not face down on the table. Somewhere else. In a 2013 study, people who talked about something meaningful with a phone just sitting nearby reported feeling less close and less understood. Later research hasn't always found the same effect, so think of it as a cheap experiment, not a rule. Ask your grandma, your dad, or your kid one question, and then just listen to the whole answer. If you try it today, text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me what you heard.
mental.notes:
https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/full/10.1177/0265407512453827
Przybylski & Weinstein 2013 (phone presence lowered closeness/trust in meaningful conversations). A 2018 replication (Communication Studies, doi 10.1080/10510974.2018.1467941) did not reproduce it; the script says so. No clinical claims.

📣 SPONSOR (read first): Z93 OFF THE CHARTS is brought to you by Schuss Mountain at Shanty Creek Resort. Trade your screen time for ski time at Northern Michigan's most authentic ski resort, where you can hit the face, take the scenic route through the glades, or send it in the terrain parks. More at shantycreek.com.

JACK JOHNSON, "BETTER TOGETHER" (2005)
- RELEASE: Opener of In Between Dreams, out March 1, 2005, on Brushfire Records. Recorded in October 2004 at The Mango Tree, his studio in Hawaii. Issued as a single in February 2006.
- THE MISS: It never entered the Billboard Hot 100. On the same album, "Sitting, Waiting, Wishing" did, peaking at No. 66. "Better Together" reached No. 12 on Billboard's Adult Alternative Airplay chart and No. 24 on the U.K. Official Singles Chart. It is certified Gold in the U.S. by the RIAA, and 2× Platinum in the U.K.
- BACKGROUND: Jack Johnson grew up surfing on the North Shore of Oahu. At 17 he made the finals of the Pipeline Masters, then a wipeout at Pipeline a week later ended that run and pushed him toward music. He studied film at UC Santa Barbara. This is the first track on In Between Dreams, which peaked at No. 2 on the Billboard 200 and is 2× Platinum in the U.S. It's a radio-clean love song whose hook is "it's always better when we're together," the right feeling the day after Thanksgiving, when the house is still full or you're heading out.
➜ TAKE: A Gold record and a No. 2 album, and Billboard never put this one on the Hot 100. The morning after Thanksgiving, this is the song for a full house.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: is it always better when we're together, or do you need a little space after Thanksgiving?
😂 JOKES: If you're still on the same couch as your cousins, Jack Johnson already wrote your theme song. / Gold at home, 2× Platinum in the U.K., and still no Hot 100.

• 'Go away! Go away!' She runs, the turkeys follow, and two strangers let her jump in their car. 'They were trying to bite your butt.'
🔊 IN: "Oh, no. Turkeys are understandably on high alert this week." (0:00)
OUT: "...trying to bite your butt." (0:47)
~0:47 · PLAY · READY

1A · KALKASKA'S DANCERS, STRANDED IN NYC
Fifteen dancers from Kalkaska's Fitch Dance Company flew to New York for the 100th Macy's parade, and then the storm pushed it to Saturday. 🎈 Now families are scrambling for hotels and flights.
Drop a shout-out for these kids in the comments! 💙
#Kalkaska #MacysParade #NorthernMichigan #Z93

1B · RECORD TURKEY TROT
Nearly 3,000 people ran or walked the Traverse City Turkey Trot yesterday, an all-time record! 🦃🏃 TC Central senior Evan Fox won the five-miler.
Did you trot? Drop your time (or your excuse)!
#TurkeyTrot #TraverseCity #Z93
📷 MEDIA: text only (lean plan: art for A options only)

2A · SHOP SMALL THIS WEEKEND
Black Friday and Small Business Saturday are happening all weekend in Downtown Traverse City! 🛍️ Deals, doorbusters and a free gift-wrapping station at participating shops.
What's the first shop on your list?
#ShopSmall #DowntownTC #TraverseCity #Z93
📷 MEDIA: /workspace/z93/fb/2026-11-27/fb2a-shop-small-tc.png

2B · CADILLAC LIGHTS UP TONIGHT
Christmas in the Park is TONIGHT in Cadillac, starting at 5:30 PM at Cadillac Commons Park! 🎄 Tree lighting, caroling, and photos with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
Who's going?
#Cadillac #ChristmasInThePark #NorthernMichigan #Z93
📷 MEDIA: text only (lean plan: art for A options only)

3A · IT'S OFFICIALLY MARIAH SEASON
Thanksgiving's over. Mariah has been released. 🎄🎶 'All I Want for Christmas Is You' came out in 1994 and didn't hit No. 1 until 2019.
When does Christmas music start at YOUR house?
#MariahCarey #ChristmasMusic #Throwback #Z93
📷 MEDIA: /workspace/z93/fb/2026-11-27/fb3a-mariah-season.png

3B · TURBO MAN TURNS 30
Jingle All the Way hit theaters 30 years ago this month (1996). 🎁 Arnold vs. Sinbad, fighting over one Turbo Man.
What's the toy YOUR parents fought the crowds for?
#JingleAllTheWay #90s #BlackFriday #Z93

hollywood.headline: The Macy's parade moved to Saturday
hollywood.summary: For the first time in 100 years, Macy's postponed its Thanksgiving parade because of the East Coast storm. It now airs Saturday at 8:30 a.m. ET on NBC and Peacock, after NBC ran a replay of last year's parade on Thursday.
hollywood.article_title: 2026 Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade Moves to Saturday, November 28: Details (NBC Insider)

Hoda says Saturday will be 'a beautiful sun-splash day.' Hoda, it's November. We'll take 'not tornado.'

lifestyle.title: MICHIGAN'S $50 BLACK FRIDAY COLLEGE BONUS
lifestyle.summary: Michigan Education Trust is giving families an extra $50 per child when they put at least $300 online into a new or existing MET account this weekend. It runs Nov. 25 through 11:59 PM Nov. 30, or until $25,000 in bonuses is gone. The bonus can take 8 to 10 weeks to show up, and grandparents and relatives can chip in.
lifestyle.article_title: Michigan families can get a $50 bonus for college savings this Black Friday (9&10 News)

localBuzz.title: KALKASKA DANCERS STUCK IN NEW YORK AFTER THE MACY'S PARADE GOT PUSHED
localBuzz.summary: Fifteen dancers from Kalkaska's Fitch Dance Company flew to New York City to perform in the 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade. Then Macy's pushed the parade from Thursday to Saturday because of the storm, the first postponement in the parade's 100 years. The group, about 60 people with families and coaches, is now scrambling over hotels, food and flights.
localBuzz.article_title: Kalkaska dancers face unexpected expenses after Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade postponement (9&10 News)

localBuzz.title: TC TURKEY TROT SETS AN ALL-TIME RECORD: NEARLY 3,000
localBuzz.summary: Nearly 3,000 runners and walkers turned out downtown Thanksgiving morning for the 19th annual Traverse City Turkey Trot, the biggest crowd it has ever had. There was a 5-K and the five-mile race called the Five Mile Flyer.
localBuzz.article_title: Traverse City Turkey Trot sets record turnout with nearly 3,000 participants (9&10 News)

localBuzz.article_title: Black Friday & Small Business Saturday (Downtown TC)

localBuzz.title: THE IRONTON FERRY WRAPS UP YEAR 100
localBuzz.summary: The Ironton Ferry on Lake Charlevoix made its last run of the season Wednesday night, closing out its 100th year in service.
localBuzz.article_title: Ironton Ferry wrapping up its 100th year in service (UpNorthLive)

localBuzz.title: 600 THANKSGIVING MEALS FROM COMMUNITY MEALS TC
localBuzz.summary: More than 50 volunteers with Community Meals Traverse City spent their Thanksgiving cooking and delivering. They prepared nearly 300 meals for delivery and another 300 for a dine-in dinner at Trinity Lutheran Church.
localBuzz.article_title: Traverse City volunteers deliver nearly 300 Thanksgiving meals, host 300 more dining-in (UpNorthLive)

officeSchool.title: OFFICE: WHO'S ACTUALLY WORKING TODAY?
officeSchool.summary: City of Traverse City offices are closed today, Nov. 26 and 27 both, per the city's own post. Plenty of other offices are open with about three people in them. If you're at work today, you're either the hero or the person who forgot to request it off.
officeSchool.article_title: City of Traverse City: City Offices Closed, November 26 & 27 (Facebook)

officeSchool.title: OFFICE: THE LEAF DEADLINE IS SUNDAY
officeSchool.summary: The City of Traverse City says the final leaf pickup pass is the week of Nov. 30, and leaves have to be at the curb by Sunday, Nov. 29. So this weekend's to-do list: leftovers, football, rake.
officeSchool.article_title: City of Traverse City: final leaf pickup (Facebook)

officeSchool.title: SCHOOL: NMC ADDS TWO ONE-YEAR MANUFACTURING CERTIFICATES
officeSchool.summary: Northwestern Michigan College's board approved two new one-year certificates for fall 2027: CAD Technology, and Precision Machining and CNC Technology. They split the existing Manufacturing Technology degree into shorter, stackable pieces, and credits carry over to the degree. NMC's Dan Goodchild says 'there are a lot of local industry jobs available.' Registration opens March 10, 2027.
officeSchool.article_title: NMC board approves two new one-year manufacturing certificates for fall 2027 (UpNorthLive)

officeSchool.title: SCHOOL: TC CENTRAL SENIOR WINS THE TURKEY TROT FIVE-MILER
officeSchool.summary: Traverse City Central senior Evan Fox won the five-mile race at yesterday's record Turkey Trot, per 9&10. Nearly 3,000 people ran or walked. Shout-out to every kid who got dragged out of bed early on a day off to run in the cold, and to the parents pulling wagons.
officeSchool.article_title: Traverse City Turkey Trot sets record turnout with nearly 3,000 participants (9&10 News)
